title: Major Memphis Health System Expands BVA® Adoption to New Hospital Outpatient Site
summary: Daxor’s ezBVA Lab Diagnostic Service Delivers 24-hour Turnaround Under Established Reimbursement Pathways to Support Ambulatory Care
body_markdown:
Daxor’s ezBVA Lab Diagnostic Service Delivers 24-hour Turnaround Under Established Reimbursement Pathways to Support Ambulatory Care


**Oak Ridge, TN – November 18, 2026 —**[Daxor Corporation](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/r01/___https://www.daxor.com/investors/___.YXAzOmRheG9yOmM6ZzpmYjYwYjZhNjUxMTMwMjc2OWYyMDllZmFlZTEwY2RmYTo3OmRjODE6YzljODhmNDU3YzgxZDM0ZjRjMzc3YTY5ZDkwZmI3NWVhYjE2ZTI1N2E3MjBjMGNjNjNmM2RkMTQ4Y2IyMTNmNDpwOlQ6Tg) (Nasdaq: DXR), the global leader in blood volume measurement technology, today announced that a major Memphis health system has expanded its Blood Volume Analysis (BVA) program to an additional hospital campus, utilizing Daxor’s ezBVA Lab service to support outpatient clinic testing.


The launch builds on established clinical utilization within the health system, demonstrating how multi-hospital networks can replicate BVA programs across campuses without capital budgets or specialized laboratory buildouts. Utilizing Daxor’s Oak Ridge diagnostic laboratory, the newly onboarded outpatient clinic receives actionable blood volume results within 24 hours, supported by existing reimbursement codes.


“Replicating adoption across multiple facilities within the same health system is a core driver of our commercial expansion,” said Annette Plishka, SVP of Commercialization at Daxor. “Because ezBVA Lab centralizes the analytical workflow in Tennessee, hospitals can bring new outpatient clinic locations online rapidly and cost-effectively. That operational simplicity accelerates our multi-site rollout, scales recurring diagnostic revenue, and equips care teams to manage patients before an acute hospitalization occurs.”


**About Daxor Corporation**


[Daxor Corporation](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/r01/___https://daxor.com/___.YXAzOmRheG9yOmM6ZzpmYjYwYjZhNjUxMTMwMjc2OWYyMDllZmFlZTEwY2RmYTo3OmUwOTk6ZDc1YzdmZmIxODE3YWJlMGMxYTUwNmM1OTgzMGY2N2ExZmY1MzAyMDZlYmM0NzkyMmU2MjNiYzJhZGFmZjNhMjpwOlQ6Tg) (Nasdaq: DXR) is tackling healthcare’s “multi-billion-dollar silent crisis”, the inability to precisely measure blood volume. This often results in suboptimal care, prolonged hospital stays, and increased readmissions for many high-cost medical conditions like heart failure and those requiring ICU care. With 50 years of experience and innovation, Daxor is proud to manufacture and distribute its patented, FDA-cleared Blood Volume Analysis (BVA) diagnostic which offers unmatched, real-time, precise data via its rapid, hand-held, lab-based system. This empowers clinicians to make individualized treatment decisions that significantly improve patient outcomes and deliver substantial efficiencies in value-based healthcare. Daxor is ISO certified and operates a U.S.-based, 20,000-square-foot state-of-the-art manufacturing facility, positioning the company for accelerated market expansion.
